REQ_DESCRIPTION: Citizen can grant consent to a data principal for a specific purpose
Citizen must give explicit voluntary consent before data access
Citizen can revoke consent at any time
Consent revocation cascades to all connected services
Citizen can view their full consent history
Citizen can export consent data
Trust node can register with the registry
Trust nodes can federate consent state via signed sync
Consent policy must be evaluated before any grant or revoke
System must fail-closed on policy evaluator error
Consent API p99 latency < 80ms under normal load
Federation sync p99 < 1500ms
All personal data stored only within India
Audit log is tamper-evident (Merkle root)
Zero cloud SDK leakage in service layer
Data minimisation — only declared fields collected
Retention — personal data deleted/archived per retention schedule
Citizen has right to access their data
Citizen has right to correct — revoke and re-grant
Citizen has right to erasure — consent deleted on revoke + retention expiry
Breach notified to DPBI within 72h
All federation syncs validated with KMS signature
Fail-closed: PDP error → deny
Outbox payload contains no PII
SBOM generated per service at release
Artefacts signed with Cosign keyless (SLSA L3)
